token_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0])
access_token = token_resp['access_token']

# paginated search for the album
query = 'Echo Chamber Chronicles'
page_limit = 20
all_albums = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.search_albums(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # response might be [] if no more
    if not resp:
        break
    all_albums.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('total_albums_found', len(all_albums))
# print summary
summary = []
for a in all_albums:
    summary.append({
        'album_id': a.get('album_id'),
        'title': a.get('title'),
        'artists': [ar.get('name') for ar in a.get('artists', [])],
        'release_date': a.get('release_date')
    })
print('album_summaries', summary)

# choose exact title match (case-insensitive)
exact = [a for a in all_albums if str(a.get('title','')).lower() == query.lower()]
print('exact_matches_count', len(exact))
if exact:
    # if multiple exact, prefer one with most songs
    exact_sorted = sorted(exact, key=lambda x: len(x.get('song_ids', []) or []), reverse=True)
    chosen = exact_sorted[0]
else:
    # fallback: choose closest match by title similarity (simple contains)
    # but we will avoid fuzzy guess: prefer titles containing the words
    contains = [a for a in all_albums if query.lower().replace(' ','') in str(a.get('title','')).lower().replace(' ','')]
    print('contains_matches_count', len(contains))
    chosen = contains[0] if contains else (all_albums[0] if all_albums else None)

print('chosen_album', None if not chosen else {'album_id': chosen['album_id'], 'title': chosen['title']})

# Log in again to ensure token available
spotify_password = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
token_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
access_token = token_resp['access_token']

album_id = 1
album = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id)
print('album', {'album_id': album.get('album_id'), 'title': album.get('title'), 'song_ids_count': len(album.get('songs', []) or [])})
print('album_song_ids_from_songs', [s.get('id') for s in (album.get('songs') or [])])
# Prefer songs list from show_album
songs = album.get('songs') or []
song_ids = [s['id'] for s in songs if 'id' in s]
print('song_ids', song_ids, 'count', len(song_ids))

# Fetch play_count for each song
track_info = []
for sid in song_ids:
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    track_info.append({
        'song_id': sd.get('song_id'),
        'title': sd.get('title'),
        'play_count': sd.get('play_count'),
        'artists': [a.get('name') for a in (sd.get('artists') or [])]
    })

# sort by play_count ascending then song_id
track_info_sorted = sorted(track_info, key=lambda x: (x['play_count'] if x['play_count'] is not None else float('inf'), x['song_id']))
print('track_info_play_counts', track_info_sorted)
least = track_info_sorted[0] if track_info_sorted else None
print('least_listened', least)

# Play the least listened song
play_resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=access_token, song_id=least['song_id'])
print('play_resp', play_resp)

least_title='Lost in the Mists of Time'
apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print('completed')
